title: Frontend is Only Visual Styling
description: Believing frontend engineering only entails styling mockups rather than handling network state, performance budgets, accessibility, client caching, and complex data logic.
indicators: Assuming frontend engineers do not write algorithms or business logic
Treating frontend solely as CSS aesthetics
correction: Frontend engineering encompasses client architecture, asynchronous state, web platform APIs, security, accessibility, and high-performance UI rendering.

title: JavaScript Replaces Semantic HTML
description: Believing modern single page applications can replace semantic HTML structure with generic <div> tags and JavaScript event listeners.
indicators: Ignoring native form elements and accessibility trees
correction: Semantic HTML provides built-in accessibility, keyboard navigation, SEO, and browser platform optimizations that JavaScript cannot replace.

title: All HTML Elements Require Closing Tags
description:
Believing void elements such as , , and
require closing tags like in HTML5.
indicators: Confusing XML/XHTML strict rules with standard HTML5 void element parsing
correction:
In HTML5, void elements (e.g. , ,
,

title: Confusing Padding and Margin
description: Treating padding and margin interchangeably without understanding their relationship to background colors, borders, and click target hitboxes.
indicators: Using margin to increase click target area of a button
Expecting element background color to fill margin space
correction: Padding is space inside the border (included in element click area and backgrounds), while margin is external clearance outside the border.

title: Confusing justify-content and align-items Axes
description: Assuming justify-content is always horizontal and align-items is always vertical regardless of flex-direction.
indicators: Expecting justify-content to remain horizontal when flex-direction is column
correction: justify-content aligns along the MAIN axis, and align-items aligns along the CROSS axis. When flex-direction is column, the main axis is vertical.

title: Equating console.log with Function Return Values
description: Believing printing a value to the browser console returns that value to the caller.
indicators: Using console.log() and expecting the outer expression to receive the logged value instead of undefined
correction: console.log() is an output side-effect for developer inspection. Only the 'return' keyword passes data back to the function caller.

title: Shotgun Debugging
description: Randomly modifying lines of code without forming a diagnostic hypothesis or checking console error outputs.
indicators: Making multiple speculative changes at once without testing each individually
correction: Systematic debugging isolates failure reproduction, inspects call stacks and error messages, and tests isolated hypotheses one by one.
